Hi Grace —

Really sorry, I need to flag that I woke up with pretty bad food poisoning (I think from dinner last night). I'm in no shape to do a 90-minute interview tomorrow morning. I can do either:
- a late afternoon slot tomorrow (after 4pm PT), or
- record the paired coding exercise via CoderPad (if you can send instructions) and do a short 20–30 minute follow-up call another day.

I know this is last-minute — if rescheduling is easiest that's fine. I don't have a doctor's note but I wanted to be transparent. Happy to be flexible on times next week.

Apologies again,

Can you reply here with availability / preference:
- Proceed later today as a full panel (if you can be available after 4pm PT)
- Run a reduced live panel (20–30 min behavioral + 30 min system design) and record pair exercise separately
- Cancel and reschedule for next week (if the panel prefers full session)

If we need to reschedule, I can send a Doodle and propose two slots next week (Tue/Wed morning PT). I attached the original invite for reference.

Thanks — Grace

Thanks all — quick thoughts:
- I can be available after 4pm PT today if Markus can join remotely; since Markus is on a plane that may not work.
- I'm comfortable covering behavioral and a short systems discussion (~30 minutes) today if we can record the pair for asynchronous review. That would allow us to keep momentum and still make a decision with less candidate stress.
- If Alex prefers reschedule, I'm okay with Tue/Wed next week too.

If we go async pair: Grace, can you confirm which platform we'll use (CoderPad link) and whether Alex is comfortable with a recorded session? Alex — if you'd prefer to reschedule entirely I understand. No pressure.

Marissa
